notes: Original research article (Progress in Natural Science: Materials International 2013;23(3):308-316), no review/thesis/patent. record.json is_retracted is false; text layer has no retraction, erratum or withdrawal notice. Gravimetric IGA (Hiden) H2 uptake at 77 K, 0-20 bar, buoyancy-corrected, on templated carbons FA-ZTC1/2/3 and compacted FA-ZTC3 (C5, C10); templated carbons are >98% carbon after HF/HCl removal of zeolite (TGA residue stated below 2% at 620 C). BET area measured by N2 at -196 C on the same samples (Tables 1 and 2). Paper does not state that its H2 uptake values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. Observations for later extraction, not affecting eligibility: text calls 7.3 wt% (FA-ZTC1) 'total' and gives 'excess' 6.2 wt% for FA-ZTC1 plus a Langmuir-extrapolated 9.22 wt%; Fig. 9 plots a FA-ZTC point near 6.0 wt% where Table 1 gives 6.2 for FA-ZTC3; Fig. 7 FA-ZTC2 and FA-ZTC3 curves show non-zero start points (about 2.0 and 1.4 wt%) at the lowest pressure.
